name: Ticrynafen

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 4 other countries, first in 1980 — for liver harm

summary: Ticrynafen was pulled from the market in the United States and four other countries starting in 1980 due to liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium score of 60 for liver risk [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low score of 18 for heart risk [M].
